summary: Mock fallback behavior removed - DelegatingAiService fell back to MockAiService when no API key was configured (user preferences empty and no BuildConfig fallback). New TextGenerationServiceImpl throws "No AI provider configured" failure instead.
failure_scenario: User without API key configured gets hard failure instead of working mock responses for resume analysis, cover letter generation, interview practice, and career roadmaps.

summary: Conversation history API removed - AiService had chat(history: List<AiMessage>) for multi-turn conversations. New TextGenerationService only has generateText(prompt: String). InterviewRepositoryImpl bypasses domain service and uses SDK AIProvider.chat() directly, creating architectural inconsistency.
failure_scenario: Interview feature works (uses SDK directly) but resume/cover letter/roadmap features lose conversation context. No domain-level chat API for feature modules to use.

summary: Domain conversation types removed - AiMessage and AiRole enum deleted from domain layer. SDK has its own AiMessage but feature modules using TextGenerationService have no way to pass conversation history.
failure_scenario: Feature modules wanting multi-turn conversations (e.g., iterative resume refinement, follow-up questions) have no domain types to express message history.

summary: API key resolution from user preferences removed - DelegatingAiService read geminiApiKey from UserPreferencesRepository (user config) with BuildConfig fallback. New TextGenerationServiceImpl uses ProviderRegistry which requires explicit provider registration, no user-preference-driven API key injection.
failure_scenario: User enters API key in settings but it's not automatically picked up by AI provider. ProviderRegistry must be configured separately, breaking the user-preference-driven AI configuration flow.

summary: Test still mocks deleted AiService interface - imports core.network.AiService and mocks analyzeText(), but ResumeRepositoryImpl now uses TextGenerationService.generateText(). Test will fail to compile or test wrong interface.
failure_scenario: Test compiles against deleted interface or tests mock behavior that doesn't match new implementation. No test coverage for TextGenerationServiceImpl error paths (no provider, provider failure).

summary: No provider selection strategy - findAvailableProvider() picks first provider with status Ready. Old DelegatingAiService used user-configured API key to initialize specific Gemini provider. New code has no way to honor user's provider choice from settings.
failure_scenario: User configures OpenRouter API key in settings but app picks first available provider (e.g., Ollama if running locally) instead of user's chosen provider.
